values.note: Electric sites $36 a night (the Forest Service builds it as $26 per camping unit + $10 electric). Additional vehicle $13-23 a night, paid to the host on arrival. The Forest Service also lists a $26 non-electric single site, but recreation.gov's catalog has none.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232156/rates (Peak Season 2026-06-12 to 2026-09-12 and 2027: RV ELECTRIC 36, STANDARD ELECTRIC 36; first-come seasons the same) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/one-mile-campground-gunnison-rd ('Single Site Non-Electric: $26 per night'; 'Single Site Electric: $36 per night'; 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $13-$23 per night'; '$26 per night per camping unit; $10 per night electric fee') + recreation.gov notice ('Extra Vehicles: Cannot be paid for in advance - upon arrival coordinate with the host'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: recreation.gov catalog 232156 ('Electricity Hookup: 15' on all 18 sites, the 13 reservable ones included; no water or sewer hookup listed) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232156 ('all of which have electric hookups'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: recreation.gov lists 18 electric sites (13 reservable, 5 first-come: 002, 006, 009, 010, 020), RV lengths 30-45 ft; the Forest Service says 25 campsites. One camping unit per standard site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/one-mile-campground-gunnison-rd ('There are 25 campsites.') + catalog 232156 (Max Vehicle Length 30/35/40/45, Pull-Through at 002, 006-009, 013-017; 99 at 007, 008, 015, 023 is a placeholder and was not used) + recreation.gov notice ('Standard Single Family sites: Recreation Use Fee allows ONE camping unit ONLY'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No drinking water: bring your own or fill up at Lottis Creek Campground. Nearest dump station about 16 miles north. Firewood sold ($10 a bundle); campground host.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/one-mile-campground-gunnison-rd ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'; '$10 per firewood bundle') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232156 ('WATER IS NOT AVAILABLE at this campground - Please bring your own water or fill up at Lottis Creek Campground'; 'Nearest dump station is approximately 16 miles north'; amenities Firewood, Host), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Late spring to early fall, weather dependent.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/one-mile-campground-gunnison-rd ('Seasons of Use: Late Spring to Early Fall - weather dependent') + recreation.gov notice ('Opening and closing dates are weather permitting'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov at least four days ahead; five sites are first-come and must be claimed in person (don't call). Two-night weekend minimum on reservations. Reservation season 2026 June 12 - Sept 12 (2027: June 11 - Sept 12); recreation.gov sells first-come walk-ins either side (2026 from May 15 to Oct 4). A late arrival is not a no-show until 24 hours after check-in time.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232156 (rules reservationCutOff 4, minWeekendStay 2, maxConsecutiveStay 14; notices 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person', 'campers are not considered a "no-show" until 24 hours after arrival date check in time') + /rates (Peak Season 2026-06-12 to 2026-09-12, 2027-06-11 to 2027-09-12; First-come seasons 2026-05-15 to 06-11 and 2026-09-13 to 10-04) + catalog (5 sites not reservable) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/one-mile-campground-gunnison-rd ('This site has a combination of first come, first serve and reservable campsites'), read 2026-10-28

note: Gunnison NF campground in Taylor Canyon, 8 mi up Taylor Canyon Road (CR 742) from Almont and 18 mi from Gunnison, in lodgepole pine and aspen on the south side of the road across from the Taylor River; river access for rafting, kayaking and trout fishing, Fossil Ridge Wilderness nearby. --Claude

Website: recreation.gov only; add or prefer the FS page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/one-mile-campground-gunnison-rd.
Ownership: federal (Gunnison NF), concessionaire-operated (rrmofa.com contact on recreation.gov). Class fine.

Site count conflict: FS 'There are 25 campsites'; recreation.gov's catalog has 18 (numbers 001-023 with gaps). The FS also lists a $26 non-electric site rate that matches no catalogued site.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront) confirmed on Esri imagery, but recreation.gov says 'The campground lies on the banks of the Taylor River' - a contrary operator claim, so a re-audit lead: every site is on the south side of Taylor Canyon Road (CR 742); the river runs on the far (north) side of the road, ~40-80 m from the sites with the road between.

Pin 38.7272,-106.7592 (recreation.gov facility point) is at the west entrance by sites 21-23, ~256 m from the 18-site centroid (38.72886,-106.75716); within 500 m. The FS coordinate 38.730731,-106.753979 is at the east end by site 1.
